title: A poison message stalls a consumer group and downstream events stop flowing
source_note: Failure pattern (a single un-processable message that a consumer retries forever, blocking the partition so the whole consumer group falls behind and downstream systems stop receiving events) is a common queue/streaming class. All services, topics, log lines, metrics, and timestamps are fabricated for evaluation.
incident_report: Since ~13:00 UTC order confirmation emails and fulfillment handoffs have stopped. Orders are still being placed fine. No deploys. The events pipeline seems stuck.

signal_lines.msg: failed to deserialize message at partition 3 offset 88214102: unexpected field 'legacy_promo'; retrying
partition 3 offset stuck at 88214102 for 2 minutes; same message failing on every retry
consumer group lag on 'order-events' now 190000 and rising; partition 3 not advancing
order-api is producing to order-events normally; the block is entirely on the consumer side at partition 3
operator routed offset 88214102 to the dead-letter queue and skipped it; partition 3 advancing, lag draining

ground_truth.root_cause: A single malformed message arrived on partition 3 of the 'order-events' topic (an unexpected 'legacy_promo' field the consumer cannot deserialize). events-consumer retried that message forever instead of skipping it, so partition 3's offset never advanced and the consumer stopped processing anything behind it. Consumer-group lag climbed to ~190,000 and downstream event delivery (confirmation emails, fulfillment handoffs) dropped to zero. Orders themselves were unaffected because order-api produces to the topic normally - the block is entirely on the consumer side. Recovery required routing the poison message to a dead-letter queue and skipping it.
evidence_path: events-consumer ERROR: failed to deserialize the message at partition 3 offset 88214102 (unexpected field 'legacy_promo'); retrying
events-consumer WARN: partition 3 offset stuck; the same message fails every retry
consumer_group_lag climbs to ~190,000 and downstream_events_per_s drops to 0
order-api is producing to the topic normally - the block is on the consumer side at partition 3
the pipeline drains once the poison offset is dead-lettered and skipped
ground_truth.fix: Dead-letter and skip the poison message (done). Add a retry limit that routes a message to the DLQ after N failures, make the consumer tolerant of unknown fields, and alert on per-partition offset stalls.
